steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Start on the Cockpit, the app's home screen for watching a stock's simulated tape.
steps.point_out: The navigation bar across the top, with Structure as one of its five pages.

steps.title: Open the Structure page
steps.narration: Click into Structure, home of the app's price-structure research tools.
steps.point_out: The page now opens to a simple prompt instead of a wall of numbers — pick a symbol and a moment in time to see its map.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its tradable level map.

steps.title: Pick a stock
steps.narration: Type AAPL into the Symbol field.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Pick a moment in time
steps.narration: Enter an as-of time from the middle of a real trading session — everything shown afterward is built only from data available up to that exact moment, never a peek into the future.
steps.point_out: The As-of field now reads the chosen date and time.

steps.title: See the short list of zones that matter
steps.narration: Click Load. Instead of a giant list of every minor price level, the page now shows a short, ranked list of the handful of zones that actually matter for this stock.
steps.point_out: Exactly ten rows appear, with the zone around $300 to $302 near the top, marked Class A and flagged as a round number.

steps.title: Peek behind the curtain
steps.narration: Curious how this page used to look? Click Show raw levels to bring back the original, longer view.
steps.point_out: The original chart and level list reappear completely unchanged — now tucked one click away instead of being the only option.

steps.title: Search real examples
steps.narration: Scroll down to Case Studies and narrow its history to one stock by typing into its Symbol box.
steps.point_out: The list narrows down to AAPL's own history of price touching a mapped zone.

steps.title: Open a real example
steps.narration: Click one of the AAPL rows from June 22, 2026 — a day price actually tested that same top zone.
steps.point_out: The example opens to show exactly what happened: the touch was rejected, and price moved lower afterward across both tracked follow-up windows.

steps.title: An honest too-soon-to-know case
steps.narration: Now click the most recent AAPL example instead, the one marked truncated horizon.
steps.point_out: Rather than guessing at an outcome, the app says plainly that not enough time has passed yet to know how this one turned out.

steps.title: Check the honest scorecard
steps.narration: Further down, the new Edge Report compares three trading approaches side by side.
steps.point_out: Right now it states plainly that there isn't qualifying trade data yet, rather than making up a result.

steps.title: Confirm nothing else moved
steps.narration: Scroll further still, and the strategy list and current champion are exactly where they've always worked.
steps.point_out: Fetching real prices from Yahoo Finance, the strategy list, and the head-to-head comparison tool are all still here, just moved below the new sections.
